notes: Vomiting and diarrhoea outbreak linked by officials to contaminated drinking water; residents and media point to leakage/sewage contamination of the supply. 'cases' = 436 patients admitted to hospitals since 29 Dec 2025 (as reported 14 Jan 2026), not lab-confirmed cases. Death figures differ by source: administration confirmed 6, an audit report suggested 15 of 21 deaths may be linked, residents claimed 23. Map position is city-level (approximate).
At least 30 households reported diarrhoea and stomach infections on 4 Jan 2026. Individual case count not given. Map position is city-level (approximate).

The report described four confirmed and six suspected cases across three areas. It mentioned suspected contaminated drinking water in one area and suspected contaminated food in another; it did not establish a single confirmed water source. Coordinates are an approximate district-level map position. Media-reported, not independently verified.

The report described a cholera outbreak at a private care home in Neyyattinkara. The article did not give a case count and said water samples were being tested to identify the source; it did not confirm contaminated water as the cause. Coordinates are an approximate town-level map position. Media-reported, not independently verified.
